name: Declared Burnol/co-Poisson atom family
criterion: Atoms are generated before target residual is inspected; support, parity, Mellin vanishings, and scale ladder are declared.

name: Dirichlet shadow map
criterion: Every Burnol atom used for visibility has a declared arithmetic coefficient shadow in the Hecke/Dirichlet coefficient space.

name: Shadow fidelity
criterion: Normalized defect $\delta_{BD,N}=\|B_N-\mathcal D_N A_N\|$ is controlled.

name: Source lower frame
criterion: $G_{\mathcal X,N}\succeq\gamma_NH_N$ on the source-readable coefficient space.

name: No-smuggling
criterion: Burnol atoms, Dirichlet supports, characters, and weights are not chosen from zero locations or the final inequality.

name: Conrey-Li survival
criterion: The hybrid dictionary must not reduce to a de Branges/RKHS shift-positivity condition.
